title: Trump says US will be ‘strongly involved’ in Venezuela oil industry after Caracas attacked and Maduro captured – live
summary: Donald Trump says Nicolás Maduro and wife captured by US during ‘large scale strike against Venezuela’ Full report: US captures Maduro during ‘large scale’ attack Why has US attacked Caracas and captured Venezuela’s president? What we know so far about the attack Watch: Aircraft fly low over Caracas as explosions hit city The Reuters news agency says it has been told by a US official, speaking on the condition of anonymity, that the US carried out strikes inside Venezuela on Saturday . The unnamed official did not provide details. As mentioned earlier, the White House and Pentagon did not immediately respond to request for comment on Saturday morning. Continue reading...
